parameters.name: FirmwareId
parameters.description:
The ID of the OTA upgrade package, which is the unique identifier of the OTA upgrade package.

The OTA upgrade package ID is one of the parameters returned when you invoke [CreateOTAFirmware](~~147311~~) to create an OTA upgrade package.

You can invoke [ListOTAFirmware](~~147450~~) to view the ID from the response parameters.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
